title: Reindexed restriction
statement: Let $n$ and $k$ be natural numbers, let $p$ be a real-valued function on the sign cube of dimension $n$, let $J\subseteq\mathrm{Fin}(n)$, and fix signs on the coordinates outside $J$. Given a bijection from $\mathrm{Fin}(k)$ to $J$, define a function on the sign cube of dimension $k$ by restricting $p$ to those fixed outside signs and reindexing the remaining coordinates using the bijection.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
a sign assignment on indices outside $J$
